name: The Wreck
source:
The Wreck is a mature 3D visual novel about sisterhood, motherhood, grief and survival. Follow failed screenwriter Junon as she attempts to make it through the most pivotal day in her life. Relive the past, alter the present, and embrace the future - or watch Junon’s story end in a wreck.

At 36, Junon’s life is in pieces: her career has stalled, she’s emotionally numb, and her personal life is falling apart. Things come to a head when she’s called to the ER to find her estranged mother in a critical condition. This is the most important day of Junon’s life, and unless something changes, it might be her last.

[From [url=https://thepixelhunt.itch.io/the-wreck-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《转瞬回忆》是一部成熟向3D视觉小说，讲述姐妹情谊、母爱、悲伤与求生。跟随失意编剧朱诺，陪她度过人生中最关键的一天。重温过去、改变当下、拥抱未来——否则，就看着朱诺的故事以一场灾难收场。

36岁的朱诺人生支离破碎：事业停滞，情感麻木，个人生活也一团糟。得知疏远的母亲病危、被送进急诊室后，所有问题终于一齐爆发。这是朱诺人生中最重要的一天；如果什么都不改变，也可能是她的最后一天。[引自[url=https://thepixelhunt.itch.io/the-wreck-demo]itch.io[/url]]
